meta.name: academic-research
meta.description: Search and fetch academic papers and archives via inference.sh CLI. Apps: arXiv Search, arXiv Paper, bioRxiv Search, bioRxiv Paper, ChemRxiv Search, ChemRxiv Paper, Internet Archive Search, Metadata, Download, Wayback Machine, You.com Search, Deep Research, Contents, Finance Research. Capabilities: preprint search with field prefixes and category filters, paper metadata and PDF download, medRxiv lookup, archive.org items, Wayback snapshots, cited deep research. Use for: literature review, paper discovery, citation lookup, research agents, summarizing papers, historical web pages. Triggers: arxiv, arxiv search, biorxiv, medrxiv, chemrxiv, preprint, research paper, academic search, literature search, paper summary, internet archive, archive.org, wayback machine, deep research, you.com, scholarly search, scientific papers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
